body:
Build a freestanding pair of playing cards

Take the two cards out of their holders and stand them on the mat by leaning them against each other. Leave them standing on their own.

The two free cards must support each other after release. Both bottom edges must rest on the mat. A half-second of continuous upper-edge contact in this arrangement earns 0.5 and permits hand support. Three seconds of stable self-support, clear of the robot and holders, earns 1.0.

| Policy | Score | Actions | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dream-1 | 0.0 | 800 of 800 | Reached the action limit in 40 simulated seconds |
| Scripted YAM | 1.0 | 558 of 800 | Completed the three-second hold at 27.90 simulated seconds |

Both trials used seed 0 and Isaac Sim 6.1.0. Each card is a rigid approximation of stiff laminated stock. The README documents the physical setup, assumed friction, build, run and score-replay commands. The board media comprise the Dream recording, full-score demonstration and initial scene.
